# What to Eat Huntsville

> Honest restaurant picks in Huntsville, Madison, Harvest and nearby Alabama, plus a few in Nashville and Atlanta, from local food creators Michaela and Arrington (@whattoeathuntsville on TikTok). Each page says what to order, where it is, and our take. We pay for our own meals unless a page says otherwise.

Full data for every restaurant (city, address, cuisines, tags, best dish, price): https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants.json

## Guides
- [Best tacos in Huntsville and Madison](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/guides/best-tacos-huntsville-madison/): The taco spots we keep going back to, and what to order at each.
- [Best wings in Huntsville and Madison](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/guides/best-wings-huntsville-madison/): Every wing spot we've tried, and the flavor to order at each.
- [Cheap eats in Huntsville and Madison](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/guides/cheap-eats-huntsville-madison/): The spots we go back to when we want to eat well and spend less.
- [Date night restaurants in Huntsville and Madison](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/guides/date-night-huntsville-madison/): Our picks for date night, and what to order at each.
- [Nashville eats](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/guides/nashville-eats/): Where we ate in Nashville, and what we'd order again.
- [Our favorites of 2025](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/guides/our-favorites-of-2025/): The Huntsville spots we kept going back to this year, in no particular order.

## Restaurants
- [North Italia](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/north-italia/): Italian, Pizza, Bridge Street Town Centre, Huntsville. Buttery truffle garlic bread, fresh margherita pizza, creamy tripoline alfredo and tiramisu. What to order at North Italia, Bridge Street Town Centre.
- [The Cheesecake Factory](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/the-cheesecake-factory/): American, Bridge Street Town Centre, Huntsville. We tried the viral Louisiana Chicken Pasta and Cajun Salmon with extra sauce, plus a mango margarita. What to order at The Cheesecake Factory, Huntsville.
- [Entice Bar & Grille](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/entice-bar-and-grille/): Wings, American, Madison Blvd, Madison. Our pick for best wings in Madison: 50-cent wings on Wednesdays (10 minimum), hot lemon pepper, and happy hour until 8pm. All under $40 at Entice.
- [Tacos de Canasta Acapulco](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/tacos-de-canasta-acapulco/): Mexican, Wall Triana Hwy, Madison. The chicken gorditas are the star: crispy tortilla and flavorful chicken. Plus steak tacos and nachos at this cheap, quick-lunch Mexican spot in Madison.
- [Viet Crispwich](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/viet-crispwich/): Asian, Sandwiches, Enterprise Way, Huntsville. Crispy shredded chicken banh mi, fried pork dumplings and loaded spicy chili broth noodles. What to order at Viet Crispwich in Huntsville.
- [Handel's Ice Cream](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/handels-ice-cream/): Sweet treats, Hwy 72 W, Huntsville. Handel's limited-time Cheesecake with Biscoff Cookies ice cream: cheesecake base, cookie butter swirl and crunchy cookie pieces. Try it in Huntsville.
- [Loona's Cafe](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/loonas-cafe/): Breakfast, Providence, Huntsville. Brunch at Loona's Cafe in Providence, Huntsville: Nashville Hot Chicken Bennie, salmon and grits, breakfast burrito, avocado toast and mimosas.
- [LOUIMA Haitian Cuisine (food truck)](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/louima-haitian-cuisine/): Caribbean, Food truck (Old Railroad Bed Rd), Madison. Fried snapper, vegetable stew, jerk chicken and pikliz from Chef Kay's Haitian food truck in Madison. Five stars from us. Opens after 4pm.
- [LawLer's Barbecue](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/lawlers-barbecue/): BBQ, South Parkway, Huntsville. Two Potato Tuesdays at LawLer's Barbecue: two huge loaded potatoes with pulled chicken or pork for $16. One of the best cheap eats in Huntsville.
- [Jet's Pizza](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/jets-pizza-madison/): Pizza, Balch Rd, Madison. Jet's Pizza on Balch Rd in Madison: 4 Corner Deep Dish, crispy thin crust, buffalo and BBQ wings, and house-made ranch you should not skip. Our take.
- [La Parrilla Mexican Restaurant](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/la-parrilla-clift-farm/): Mexican, Clift Farm, Madison. Mexican food at Clift Farm in Madison for under $60: house margaritas, tableside guacamole, fried fish tacos and the famous Sopa de Pollo. Our honest take.
- [The Spot](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/the-spot/): Soul food, Wings, Pulaski Pike, Huntsville. Our go-to for a night out: good catfish, wings, $2 drink specials and hookah at affordable prices. What to order at The Spot on Pulaski Pike in Huntsville.
- [Kyuramen](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/kyuramen/): Asian, University Dr, Huntsville. What to order at Kyuramen in Huntsville: extra hot Kyushu Spicy Tonkotsu Ramen, the yakitori platter, popcorn chicken, and matcha and s'mores tiramisu.
- [West End Grill](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/west-end-grill/): Wings, American, Old Madison Pike, Huntsville. A Huntsville staple and cheap date: lemon pepper and Jamaican jerk wings, a juicy patty melt and homemade ranch, all under $60. What to order here.
- [Pico Fresh Mex](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/pico-fresh-mex/): Mexican, Monrovia, Huntsville. Birria pizza is our favorite, plus fish tacos with pickled onions, nachos, quesadillas and margarita pitchers. Our weekly Mexican spot in Monrovia.
- [Scoop & Slice Cafe](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/scoop-and-slice/): Sweet treats, Pizza, Sandwiches, Harvest (Capshaw Rd), Harvest. Temporarily closed. Our regular Harvest spot for Philly cheesesteak pizza with Alfredo, a loaded Italian club, fresh seasoned fries and ice cream samples.
- [Pan-Z-Effie's](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/pan-z-effies/): BBQ, Soul food, Food truck (Pulaski Pike), Huntsville. Fried catfish we rate 1000/10, plus ribs, wings and mac and cheese from this Huntsville soul food and BBQ truck on Pulaski Pike. Open Wed to Sat after 4pm.
- [Parlor Doughnuts](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/parlor-doughnuts/): Breakfast, Sweet treats, Clinton Ave W, Huntsville. Three savory pizza doughnuts: Buffalo Chicken, Chicken Bacon Ranch and OG Pepperoni. We gave them 10 out of 10. Parlor Doughnuts, Clinton Ave, Huntsville.
- [Rooster's](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/roosters-athens/): Chicken, US-31, Athens. A quick drive-thru stop in Athens: the sauce was the star, then the tenders, fries and sweet tea. A little pricey, but honestly worth it.
- [Osteria Luca](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/osteria-luca/): Italian, Pizza, Stovehouse, Huntsville. The hot honey meatball pizza was the one, plus a crispy Caesar salad and chicken mushroom fettuccine alfredo. Italian near Stovehouse in Huntsville.
- [Barracuda Taco Stand](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/barracuda-taco-stand/): Mexican, Meridian St, Huntsville. Made-to-order tacos on Meridian St: a juicy pork taco with pickled onions was our favorite, plus chicken and crispy fish tacos and a 10/10 lime margarita.
- [Dragon Alley](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/dragon-alley/): Asian, MidCity, Huntsville. Yaki udon we'd go back for, soft duck bao and earthy cocktails, plus karaoke and a nightly DJ. Our honest review of Dragon Alley in MidCity, Huntsville.
- [Viet House](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/viet-house/): Asian, Airport Rd, Huntsville. Our forever-favorite pho spot: spicy chicken pho, fried spring rolls and pork dumplings, all under $40. What to order at Viet House in Huntsville.
- [Hattie B's Hot Chicken](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/hattie-bs-huntsville/): Chicken, Memorial Pkwy (Stadium Commons), Huntsville. Nashville hot chicken in Huntsville: medium hot tenders and wings, Dirty Bird Fries and the Poppy Seed Grilled Chicken Salad. Tastes like the original.
- [Metro Diner](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/metro-diner/): Breakfast, American, Airport Rd (Westburg Shopping Ctr), Huntsville. Loaded fries, crispy fish and chips and steak tips with mashed potatoes, all under $50. Breakfast is served at dinner too at Metro Diner in Huntsville.
- [Steam Boys](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/steam-boys/): Asian, Clift Farm, Madison. One of our favorites in Madison: beef bao, cheeseburger dumplings, popcorn chicken and passion fruit boba. All-you-can-eat dumplings Thursdays for $20.
- [Vujee Vegan](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/vujee-vegan/): Vegan, Meridian St N, Huntsville. Black-owned vegan spot with five-star chili, a buffalo chick'n sandwich, Philly egg rolls and waffle fries. What to order at Vujee Vegan in Huntsville.
- [City Barbeque](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/city-barbeque/): BBQ, South Huntsville, Huntsville. Smoky wings, mac and cheese with a real cheese pull, and meaty green beans, about $32 for two. What to order at City Barbeque in South Huntsville.
- [Cooper's Hawk](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/coopers-hawk/): American, Clift Farm, Madison. Worth the hype at Clift Farm: prime rib sandwich, surf and turf, chicken potstickers and a 10/10 s'mores budino. What to order at Cooper's Hawk in Madison.
- [Hunnydew Bakery](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/hunnydew-bakery/): Sweet treats, Home bakery / farmers market, Huntsville. We gave Hunnydew Bakery a 10 out of 10. Cinnamon sparkle, chocolate lava and velvet dreams cookies from a Black-owned, gluten-friendly Huntsville baker.
- [Blue Oak BBQ](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/blue-oak-bbq/): BBQ, MidCity, Huntsville. BBQ in MidCity with daily specials, margaritas and beer-battered tots. We got the Winter Burger, mild buffalo wings and baked beans, and want to go back.
- [Jon Smith Subs](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/jon-smith-subs/): Sandwiches, County Line Rd, Madison. Get the hot Cajun chicken sandwich at Jon Smith Subs in Madison: cheesy, fresh and hot. Weekday $10 sandwich, chips and drink deal on County Line Rd.
- [Sunnyside Pizzeria](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/sunnyside-pizzeria-atlanta/): Pizza, Sandy Springs, Atlanta. A road-trip pick near Atlanta: the Honey Hot Pizza with pepperoni is fresh, cheesy and sweet-hot. Alfredo pasta, spritz drinks and gelato in Sandy Springs.
- [Chikin Jip](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/chikin-jip/): Asian, Chicken, County Line Rd, Madison. Spicy yangnyeom boneless chicken with fries and bulgogi fries. Fresh food and friendly service. What to order at Chikin Jip in Madison, AL.
- [Chuck's Fish](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/chucks-fish/): Seafood, Clift Farm, Madison. Date night at Clift Farm: five-star hot honey pizza, salmon sushi and parmesan-crusted grouper. Pricey but worth it. Chuck's Fish in Madison.
- [One Eleven](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/one-eleven/): American, Downtown, Huntsville. Shareable cocktails, a fresh wedge salad, fish, mussels, pasta and steak, plus a photo booth. Our take on One Eleven for date night in downtown Huntsville.
- [Wings & Gyros](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/wings-and-gyros/): Wings, Mediterranean, Sparkman Dr / UAH, Huntsville. Some of the best wings in Huntsville: hot lemon pepper and hot honey wings, fresh fries and really good ice cream. Our take on Wings & Gyros near UAH.
- [Taqueria Las Adelitas](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/taqueria-las-adelitas/): Mexican, Madison Pike, Huntsville. Get the fish taco: one of the best tacos we've ever had. We also liked the chips and salsa. What to order at Taqueria Las Adelitas in Huntsville.
- [Daylight Donuts](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/daylight-donuts-south/): Sweet treats, Breakfast, South Huntsville, Huntsville. Chocolate glazed donuts, cinnamon rolls and donut holes, plus breakfast sandwiches and pigs in a blanket. What to order at Daylight Donuts, Huntsville.
- [Fluffy Fluffy](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/fluffy-fluffy/): Sweet treats, Breakfast, Asian, Whitesburg Dr, Huntsville. Fluffy matcha souffle pancakes, lattes and cheesecake on Whitesburg Dr. Sweet, cozy and worth the stop. What to order at Fluffy Fluffy in Huntsville.
- [P.F. Chang's](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/pf-changs/): Asian, Bridge Street Town Centre, Huntsville. We worked through seven dishes at P.F. Chang's at Bridge Street Town Centre in Huntsville. Order the spicy chicken and garlic noodles. Good for groups.
- [Playa Bowls](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/playa-bowls/): Sweet treats, Breakfast, Clift Farm, Madison. Our pick for something cold: the Aloha Smoothie with protein and chia, plus the Acai Nutella Bowl. What to order at Playa Bowls, Clift Farm, Madison.
- [Field Day](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/field-day/): American, University Dr, Huntsville. Mini golf, axe throwing, bowling and a big patio for game days, plus pizza, wings and fish bowl drinks. Our take on Field Day on University Dr in Huntsville.
- [Las Trojas Cantina](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/las-trojas-cantina/): Mexican, Hazel Green, Hazel Green. Birria tacos, birria pizza, carne asada fries and the big Bama margarita at Las Trojas Cantina in Hazel Green. Great for birthdays and large groups.
- [Mozza](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/mozza-pizza/): Pizza, Jordan Ln, Huntsville. Pepperoni and sausage pizza, pasta and calzones, fast and fresh out of the oven. Mozza on Jordan Ln is in our top 3 for pizza in Huntsville.
- [Mi Tierra Oaxaqueña](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/mi-tierra-oaxaquena/): Mexican, Pulaski Pike, Huntsville. Chicken and steak tacos on corn and flour tortillas got a great rating from us. What to order at Mi Tierra Oaxaqueña on Pulaski Pike in Huntsville.
- [The Biscuit Express](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/the-biscuit-express/): Breakfast, Moores Mill Rd, Huntsville. A bacon, egg and cheese biscuit with crisp bacon and a chicken biscuit that reminded us of Jack's. What to order at The Biscuit Express on Moores Mill Rd.
- [Mo'Bay Beignet Co.](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/mobay-beignet-co/): Sweet treats, Monrovia (Jeff Rd), Huntsville. Fresh beignets with syrups, a crispy club chicken sandwich, burgers and coffee. A new Monrovia spot on Jeff Rd in Huntsville with room to sit and work.
- [Taqueria Doña Vale](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/taqueria-dona-vale/): Mexican, Wall Triana Hwy, Madison. Shredded chicken tacos, steak tacos on fresh homemade tortillas and a thick chicken sope, inside a gas station. What to order at Taqueria Doña Vale.
- [Taqueria Don Pancho](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/taqueria-don-pancho/): Mexican, Hwy 72 W, Madison. Crispy, not-soggy birria tacos, a torta mamalona big enough for two, and steak and chicken tacos. What to order at Taqueria Don Pancho in Madison, AL.
- [Floyd's Barbecue](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/floyds-barbecue/): BBQ, Pulaski Pike, Huntsville. Five stars and the best pork sandwich in Huntsville. Get the pork sandwich plate with baked beans and a juicy rib. What to order at Floyd's Barbecue.
- [Super Chix](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/super-chix-madison/): Chicken, Town Madison, Madison. Big portions by Toyota Field: crispy chicken tenders, a buffalo chicken sandwich, and loaded fries with bacon and queso. Our take on Super Chix in Madison.
- [Teriyaki Express Grill (food truck)](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/teriyaki-express-grill/): Asian, Capshaw & Wall Triana, Madison. A Madison food truck at Capshaw and Wall Triana: fried gyoza and a chicken teriyaki plate for about $15. What to order at Teriyaki Express Grill.
- [Niyah's Southern Grill](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/niyahs-southern-grill/): Soul food, Jordan Rd, Huntsville. Crispy, well-seasoned fried catfish was our favorite, plus porkchop bites, hot wings, queso mac and homemade white sauce at this Huntsville soul food spot.
- [Nicas Grill & Café (food truck)](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/nicas-grill/): Latin, Food truck, Huntsville. Nicaraguan-American fusion food truck. The loaded fries taste like Philly cheese fries, and the Valenciana rice is next. Find it at Orion and NASA Corral.
- [LJ'z Backyard Bayou](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/ljz-backyard-bayou/): Soul food, Cajun, Harvest, Harvest. Cajun and Creole food in Harvest, AL: jambalaya, shellfish-free gumbo, fried catfish and Sunday beignets. Open Friday to Sunday only. Black-owned.
- [Melt](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/melt-downtown/): American, Downtown, Huntsville. Tater tots, mac and cheese egg rolls, fried chicken sandwiches and mimosa pitchers. Our go-to for years at Melt in downtown Huntsville.
- [Rosie's](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/rosies-cantina/): Mexican, University Drive, Huntsville. A decent Tex-Mex spot on University Drive: Rotel dip, steak nachos, a beef taco and a margarita. Our honest take on Rosie's in Huntsville.
- [Mi Delicioso Guanajuato](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/mi-delicioso-guanajuato/): Mexican, Governors Dr, Huntsville. Quesabirrias with consomé, chicken tacos and flautas con pollo, all hot and fresh. What to order at Mi Delicioso Guanajuato on Governors Dr in Huntsville.
- [Aloha Ramen House](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/aloha-ramen-house/): Asian, Hughes Rd, Madison. Comfort food in Madison: fried gyoza, crispy chicken katsu and spicy tonkotsu ramen with chicken or pork, plus a yuzu white peach drink. What to order.
- [Beignets & Brew](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/beignets-and-brew/): Sweet treats, County Line Rd, Madison. A caramel latte and beignets with chocolate sauce at Beignets & Brew on County Line Rd in Madison. It is just up the street, so we might go too often.
- [Lyli Viet-Thai Cuisine (Phomous)](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/lyli-viet-thai/): Asian, Hwy 72 W, Madison. Chicken gyoza, chicken pho with add-ins and really spicy lemongrass chicken. What to order at Lyli Viet-Thai Cuisine, also called Phomous, in Madison.
- [Tulum Cantina](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/tulum-cantina/): Mexican, Martin Rd, Huntsville. A rare sit-down spot for birria in Huntsville: birria tacos, a birria quesadilla and refreshing mango and lime margaritas. What to order at Tulum Cantina.
- [Bo's Best Wings](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/bos-best-wings/): Wings, Blue Spring Rd, Huntsville. Serving flavor since 1998: we got fried wings, hot lemon pepper and hot honey wings, and fried catfish with fries. Everything was so good. Our take.
- [Pita Street Food](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/pita-street-food/): Mediterranean, Hughes Rd, Madison. One of our favorite grab-and-go spots in Madison. Get the grilled chicken gyro combo with fries, steak fries and raspberry lemonade at Pita Street Food.
- [Taqueria Los 3 Reales (food truck)](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/taqueria-los-3-reales/): Mexican, South Huntsville, Huntsville. Our regular South Huntsville taco truck: steak tacos, chicken tacos and sopes, with tortas next on our list. Cash only. What to order at Los 3 Reales.
- [Taqueria Luna](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/taqueria-luna/): Mexican, Food truck, Madison. Crispy, cheesy birria tacos were the star of the show, plus a birria quesadilla, steak and chicken tacos. What to order at Taqueria Luna in Madison, AL.
- [A-Town Wings](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/a-town-wings/): Wings, North Huntsville, Huntsville. Tiny but mighty wings in North Huntsville. We get honey gold, hot honey and hot lemon pepper, and you might need extra. What to order at A-Town Wings.
- [MK Wings](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/mk-wings/): Wings, Jordan Ln, Huntsville. Hot honey and hot lemon pepper wings with a side of Cajun fries is our ultimate combo. What to order at MK Wings on Jordan Ln in Huntsville.
- [Seoul Good](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/seoul-good/): Chicken, Asian, Stovehouse, Huntsville. Crunchy Korean fried chicken inside Stovehouse: a 16-piece honey mustard and sweet and spicy combo with fries and cheese corn. A good date night pick.
- [Cutes and Cupcakes](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/cutes-and-cupcakes/): Sweet treats, Stovehouse, Huntsville. Chocolate Overload cupcake and Biscoff cheesecake at Stovehouse. Cakes, cookies, brownies and more. What to order at Cutes and Cupcakes in Huntsville.
- [Los Morelenses](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/los-morelenses/): Mexican, Hwy 72 W / Old Railroad Bed, Madison. A gas station taqueria off Hwy 72 in Madison worth stopping for: a crispy quesadilla on a corn tortilla, chicken tacos on flour, and green and red sauce.
- [Sac's Kitchen](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/sacs-kitchen/): Soul food, Mastin Lake Rd, Huntsville. Soul food on Mastin Lake Rd: hot wings and fries, fried catfish with mac and cheese, green beans and cornbread, plus a buffet. Our take on Sac's Kitchen.
- [Taqueria Catedral (food truck)](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/taqueria-catedral/): Mexican, Harvest (Hwy 53 Chevron), Harvest. A good taco truck at the Chevron off Hwy 53 in Harvest. We got the steak and chicken tacos, and both were good. What to order at Taqueria Catedral.
- [Luogo](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/luogo-nashville/): Italian, The Gulch, Nashville. Grilled Margherita pizza, braised short rib, duck ragu pappardelle and bomboloni. Our date night pick at Luogo in The Gulch, Nashville.
- [Mizz Juju's](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/mizz-jujus/): Soul food, Chicken, Jordan Ln, Huntsville. Fried chicken sandwich, hot lemon pepper wings, honey gold wings and Ocean Water juice. The menu changes daily at Mizz Juju's on Jordan Ln in Huntsville.
- [China Dragon](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/china-dragon/): Asian, Wall Triana Hwy, Madison. Our go-to Chinese takeout since Michaela was a kid: General Tso's or sesame chicken with lo mein. Cheap eats at China Dragon in Madison, AL.
- [Domaine South](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/domaine-south/): American, Downtown, Huntsville. Date night downtown: salmon with risotto, steak with standout duck fat fries, and cocktails. Reservations suggested. What to order at Domaine South.
- [Big Papa Gyro](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/big-papa-gyro/): Mediterranean, University Dr, Huntsville. Around for 20 years on University Dr: the Big Papa Gyro, a chicken gyro, an amazing Greek salad and crispy fries, all with fresh ingredients. Our take.
- [Big John's](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/big-johns/): BBQ, Seafood, Soul food, The Open Bottle (Hwy 72 W), Huntsville. In our opinion, the best fried catfish in Huntsville, plus loaded buffalo and rooftop fries. At The Open Bottle, open Thursday to Saturday, 4 to 9pm only.
- [Luigi's Italian Grill](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/luigis-italian-grill/): Italian, Hwy 72, Madison. Lobster ravioli, chicken alfredo and grandma's lasagna that taste homemade. Our birthday dinner pick at Luigi's Italian Grill in Madison. Five stars.
- [RD's Smokehouse Barbecue](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/rds-smokehouse/): BBQ, Harvest (Nick Davis Rd), Harvest. A longtime favorite at the four-way stop off Nick Davis Rd. Get the loaded baked potato with brisket and try the wings at RD's Smokehouse in Harvest, AL.
- [Cap's Philly Cheesesteak](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/caps-philly-cheesesteak/): Sandwiches, Nails gas station, Huntsville. A real taste of Philly inside the Nails gas station on South Memorial Pkwy. They make their own cheese whiz, and we get our cheesesteak with provolone.
- [Little Hats Italian Market](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/little-hats-nashville/): Italian, Sandwiches, Germantown, Nashville. Craving Italian in Nashville? Little Hats Italian Market in Germantown: fried ravioli, chicken parmigiana sub and meatball sub, with gluten-free buns too.
- [Tamarind Island](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/tamarind-island/): Caribbean, The Camp, Huntsville. A Caribbean spot at The Camp in Huntsville with jerk chicken, curry goat, seafood, fish fry and vegan options. Find Tamarind Island on University Drive.
- [The Veggie](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/the-veggie/): Vegan, US-72 W, Madison. A Black-owned vegan spot in Madison on US-72 with salads, vegan burgers, po boys and bowls. We don't have a full review of The Veggie yet.
- [Mia's Cafe](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/mias-cafe/): Soul food, American, Hwy 72 W, Madison. Breakfast, sandwiches, salads, soups and a Southern-style meat and three at Mia's Cafe on Hwy 72 W in Madison. Our full take on this one is still to come.
- [The Moon Bakeshop](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/the-moon-bakeshop/): Sweet treats, Downtown, Huntsville. A downtown Huntsville bakery on Jefferson St for something sweet. We picked up a cinnamon roll and chocolate chip cookies at The Moon Bakeshop.
- [The Ruby Slipper Cafe](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/ruby-slipper-nashville/): Breakfast, Hillsboro Village, Nashville. A nice brunch stop in Nashville: sweet heat fried chicken and French toast, plus a fried chicken sandwich with fries. What to order at Ruby Slipper.
- [Superhero Chefs](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/superhero-chefs/): Vegan, Breakfast, MidCity, Huntsville. A Black-owned vegan breakfast and brunch spot in MidCity Huntsville with waffles, sandwiches and gluten-free options. Our take: it has tasty options.
- [Sam & Greg's Pizzeria](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/sam-and-gregs/): Pizza, Downtown, Huntsville. A downtown Huntsville pizza spot on the square. Our pick is the sweet and spicy BBQ pizza, and you won't regret it. What to order at Sam & Greg's Pizzeria.
- [Oh Crepe!](https://whattoeathuntsville.com/restaurants/oh-crepe/): Sweet treats, Breakfast, Stovehouse, Huntsville. Crepes inside Stovehouse in Huntsville. We tried the BLT crepe, a savory crepe with bacon. Dessert crepes, gluten-free options and shaved ice are here too.
